source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 6-24), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Computer Networks) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain step by step how a network sends data from one device to another (4). Explain how network models and layers organize this communication (4). (8 marks)
(Qadam ba qadam samjhayein ke network data aik device se doosre tak kaise bhejta hai (4). Samjhayein ke network models aur layers is communication ko kaise munazzam karte hain (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Data kaise bheja jata hai (4):
1. Bhejne se pehle data chhote packets mein toda jata hai.
2. Packets cables ya wireless signals ke zariye safar karte hain.
3. Networking devices packets ko sahi manzil (destination) tak le jate hain.
4. Receiving device packets ko jod kar asal data bana deta hai. Is tarah raabta hamwar aur tez hota hai.

Models aur layers ka kirdar (4):
1. Network models batate hain ke data munazzam tareeqe se kaise chalta hai; yeh communication ko layers (tehon) mein baant dete hain.
2. Har layer ka apna kaam hai aur data qadam ba qadam layers se guzarta hai (Figure 1.13: sender ki taraf Application layer se neeche Physical layer tak).
3. Lower layers physical data transfer, middle layers routing aur delivery, aur upper layers user applications sambhalti hain.
4. Layered models networks ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasan banate hain, troubleshooting mein madad dete hain, aur aik layer ki tabdeeli doosri par asar nahin dalti; yeh standards ke tor par istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These packets travel through cables or wireless signals.

blocks.prompt:
2 Compare a Local Area Network and a Wide Area Network in a table (5). Explain how homes reach the Internet through an ISP and DSL (3). (8 marks)
(Local Area Network aur Wide Area Network ka table mein muqabla karein (5). Samjhayein ke ghar ISP aur DSL ke zariye Internet tak kaise pohanchte hain (3).)
blocks.explanation:
LAN aur WAN (5): table dekhein.

Internet tak rasai (3):
1. Internet aik aalmi network (sab se bada WAN, public WAN) hai jo laakhon devices jodta hai aur standard protocols istemal karta hai.
2. ISP (Internet Service Provider) woh company hai jo users ko Internet deti hai; modem ghar ke network ko ISP se jodta hai.
3. DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) telephone lines se Internet deti hai aur aik hi waqt mein call aur browsing ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: It connects networks in different cities or countries.

rows: Chhote ilaqe (ghar, school, office) mein devices jodta hai.
Bada jughrafiyai ilaqa; mukhtalif shehron ya mulkon ke networks jodta hai.
Data transfer ki raftar zyada.
Data transfer ki raftar LAN se kam.
Aam tor par aik hi organization ki milkiyat aur intezam.
Leased lines, satellites ya Internet istemal karta hai.
Sasta aur sambhalne mein aasan.
Lagana aur chalana mehenga.
Ethernet aur Wi-Fi aam hain.
Internet is ki sab se badi misal hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 A student opens a website on a laptop at home. Using the networking devices of this chapter, explain the role of each device on the way from the laptop to the Internet: NIC, wireless access point or switch, router and modem (2 x 4). (8 marks)
(Aik talib ilm ghar mein laptop par website kholta hai. Is chapter ke networking devices ki madad se laptop se Internet tak raste mein har device ka kirdar samjhayein: NIC, wireless access point ya switch, router aur modem (2 x 4).)
blocks.explanation:
1. NIC: Network Interface Card laptop ko network se jodta hai; yeh wired ya wireless ho sakta hai, is ka unique MAC address hota hai aur yeh data bhejta aur leta hai. Is ke baghair laptop baat nahin kar sakta.

2. Wireless access point ya switch: access point Wi-Fi deta hai aur wireless devices ko network mein shamil karta hai (coverage barhata hai); switch wired devices ko jodta hai aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai.

3. Router: ghar ke network ka main device; mukhtalif networks jodta hai, IP addresses se packets ko sahi manzil tak bhejta hai, bahar jane wale data ke liye default gateway hai, aur NAT karta hai taake bohat se devices aik public IP address share karein.

4. Modem: ghar ke network ko ISP se jodta hai; digital data ko bhejne ke qabil signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein badalta hai. Modems cable, DSL ya fiber ke saath istemal hote hain aur aksar router ke saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Raasta yaad rakhne ka aasan tareeqa: laptop ka NIC -> Wi-Fi access point (ya switch) -> router (gateway + NAT) -> modem -> ISP -> Internet. Har device sirf apna aik kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between a switch and a router (4). What is a Network Interface Card? Explain its MAC address and its two forms (4). (8 marks)
(Switch aur router mein farq likhein (4). Network Interface Card kya hai? Is ka MAC address aur is ki do shaklein samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Switch aur router (4): table dekhein.

NIC (4):
1. Network Interface Card device ko network se jodta hai aur network se data bhejta aur leta hai.
2. Har NIC ka aik unique address hota hai jise MAC address kehte hain.
3. Yeh wired ya wireless ho sakta hai.
4. NIC ke baghair device network par baat nahin kar sakta; aksar jadeed devices mein NIC pehle se laga hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Routers connect local networks to the Internet.

rows: Devices jodta hai aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai.
Mukhtalif networks ko jodta hai.
Network ki raftar aur karkardagi behtar karta hai.
IP addresses se data packets ko manzil tak bhejta hai.
Jadeed networks mein aam hai.
Local networks ko Internet se jodta hai; security aur control behtar karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between physical and logical topology (2). Explain tree topology (3) and compare it with star topology using Table 1.1 (3). (8 marks)
(Physical aur logical topology mein farq likhein (2). Tree topology samjhayein (3) aur Table 1.1 ki madad se star topology se is ka muqabla karein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Physical aur logical (2): physical topology devices aur cables ke asal connections dikhati hai; logical topology batati hai ke network mein data kaise behta hai.

Tree topology (3):
1. Devices darakht jaisi darja ba darja (hierarchical) shakal mein lage hote hain (Figure 1.12).
2. Yeh bus aur star ko milati hai: kai star networks aik central backbone se jude hote hain; data root (main node) se branches aur sub-branches tak jata hai.
3. Bade networks barhana aur sambhalna aasan hai, magar backbone kharab ho to poora network mutasir ho sakta hai; yeh bade idaron mein aam hai.

Tree aur star (3): table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: It is easy to expand and manage large networks.

rows: Tamam devices central hub ya switch se jude hote hain.
Kai star networks aik central backbone se jude hote hain.
Lagana aur sambhalna aasan; kharabi dhoondna aasan.
Barhana aasan; bade networks ke liye munasib; darja ba darja intezam.
Central device kharab ho to poora network ruk jata hai.
Backbone kharab ho to poora network mutasir hota hai.
Zyada cable; zyada qeemat.
Pecheeda setup; zyada cabling.

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between the Network layer and the Transport layer of the OSI model (4). Explain the functions of the Physical layer and the Data Link layer (4). (8 marks)
(OSI model ki Network layer aur Transport layer mein farq likhein (4). Physical layer aur Data Link layer ke kaam samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Network layer aur Transport layer (4): table dekhein.

Physical layer (2): raw data ko electrical, optical ya radio signals ki shakal mein medium par bhejti hai; cables, connectors, voltage levels aur transmission rates jaisi hardware ki tafseelat tay karti hai.

Data Link layer (2): seedhe jude nodes ke darmiyan be-ghalti data transfer yaqeeni banati hai; framing, error detection/correction karti hai aur shared transmission medium tak rasai control karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Responsible for routing data from source to destination across different networks.

rows: Data ko source se destination tak mukhtalif networks mein routing karti hai.
Devices ke darmiyan data ki bharosemand aur tarteeb wali delivery deti hai.
Logical addressing (IP addresses) sambhalti hai.
Error recovery aur flow control karti hai.
Data delivery ka sab se behtar rasta tay karti hai.
Data ko chhote hisson (segments) mein todti hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 What does a network protocol define, and why must all devices follow the same protocol (2)? Differentiate between HTTP and HTTPS and explain how SSL/TLS protects sensitive information (6). (8 marks)
(Network protocol kya tay karta hai aur sab devices ko aik hi protocol kyun follow karna chahiye (2)? HTTP aur HTTPS mein farq likhein aur samjhayein ke SSL/TLS hassas maloomat ko kaise bachate hain (6).)
blocks.explanation:
Protocol (2): network protocol raabte ke usoolon ka majmua hai; yeh tay karta hai ke data kis format mein aur kaise bheja jaye, aur error handling aur delivery control karta hai. Sab devices aik hi protocol follow karein to data ka tabadla hamwar hota hai (protocols computers ki zaban ki tarah hain).

HTTP aur HTTPS (4): table dekhein.

SSL/TLS (2): HTTPS ki encryption SSL/TLS protocols se hoti hai, jo yaqeeni banate hain ke passwords, zaati tafseelat aur payment data jaisi hassas maloomat hamla awar aasani se beech mein na pakad sakein.

book_ref.quote: It uses encryption to protect data transmitted between a web browser and a web server.

rows: Hypertext Transfer Protocol; web pages bhejta hai.
HTTP ka mehfooz version.
Web browser aur web server ke darmiyan kaam karta hai; websites dikhata hai.
Yeh bhi browser aur server ke darmiyan, magar data ki hifazat ke saath.
Data encrypt nahin karta.
Encryption (SSL/TLS) istemal karta hai.
Mehfooz websites ke liye munasib nahin.
Mehfooz websites isi ko istemal karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
8 Using the examples 192.168.1.10 and 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334, explain the structure of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and work out the number of bits in each and the total number of addresses each version allows. (8 marks)
(192.168.1.10 aur 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 ki misalon se IPv4 aur IPv6 addresses ki banawat samjhayein aur har aik ke bits aur kul mumkin addresses nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Hisse aur har hisse ke bits ginein; kul bits = hisse x har hisse ke bits; addresses ki tadaad 2 ki power kul bits hai.

book_ref.quote: IPv4 has 4 numbers, each 0–255, separated by dots.

steps: IPv4 banawat: 4 numbers, har aik 0-255, dots se alag. 192.168.1.10 mein network part 192.168.1 local network aur host part 10 device ki pehchan hai.
IPv4 bits: har number = 1 byte = 8 bits, is liye kul = 4 x 8 = 32 bits.
IPv4 addresses: 2^32 = 4,294,967,296, yani taqreeban 4.29 billion (mehdood tadaad).
IPv6 banawat: 4 hexadecimal digits ke 8 groups, colons se alag. Global routing prefix 2001:0db8:85a3, subnet ID 0000, interface ID 0000:8a2e:0370:7334.
IPv6 bits: har group = 16 bits, is liye kul = 8 x 16 = 128 bits.
IPv6 addresses: 2^128, taqreeban 3.4 x 10^38; itni badi tadaad ke IPv6 kabhi khatam nahin honge.
blocks.final_answer: IPv4: 32 bits, taqreeban 4.29 billion addresses. IPv6: 128 bits, taqreeban 3.4 x 10^38 addresses.

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain Network Address Translation (NAT) and its benefits (4). Explain subnetting and its benefits (4). (8 marks)
(Network Address Translation (NAT) aur is ke fawaid samjhayein (4). Subnetting aur is ke fawaid samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
NAT (4):
1. NAT ka matlab Network Address Translation hai.
2. Yeh bohat se devices ko aik public IP address share karne deta hai, aur yeh kaam router karta hai.
3. Yeh devices ke private IP addresses chhupata hai.
4. Is se network security behtar hoti hai; NAT networks mein aam istemal hota hai.

Subnetting (4):
1. Subnetting network ko chhote hisson mein taqseem karti hai; har hissa subnet kehlata hai (Figure 1.15).
2. Is se network traffic kam hota hai.
3. Performance behtar aur security zyada hoti hai.
4. Bade networks intezam ke liye subnetting istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: NAT stands for Network Address Translation.

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a home network and what are its components (4)? Compare wired and wireless network connections (4). (8 marks)
(Home network kya hai aur is ke hisse kaun se hain (4)? Wired aur wireless network connections ka muqabla karein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Home network aur is ke hisse (4):
1. Home network ghar ke devices, jaise computers, mobile phones aur printers, ko jodta hai taake woh baat karein aur aik hi internet connection share karein; durust configuration raftar aur hifazat behtar karti hai.
2. Router: main device; network ke tamam devices jodta hai.
3. Modem: ghar ke network ko internet service provider se jodta hai.
4. Network devices (computers, laptops, mobile phones), wired connections ke liye network cables, aur wireless devices ke liye Wi-Fi signals.

Wired aur wireless (4): table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Ethernet cables are commonly used in wired networks.

rows: Cables istemal hoti hain; Ethernet cables aam hain.
Bina cables, radio signals se devices jodta hai.
Devices seedha router ya switch se jude hote hain.
Gharon mein Wi-Fi sab se aam technology hai.
Tez raftar aur mustahkam performance; zyada mehfooz.
Kuch suraton mein wired se sust ho sakta hai.
Cables ki wajah se devices aazadi se hil nahin sakte.
Range ke andar devices aazadi se hil sakte hain; lagana aur chalana aasan.

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is Wi-Fi security needed (2)? Explain router configuration through the router web interface, Wi-Fi encryption and guest networks (2 x 3). (8 marks)
(Wi-Fi security kyun zaroori hai (2)? Router web interface ke zariye router configuration, Wi-Fi encryption aur guest networks samjhayein (2 x 3).)
blocks.explanation:
Wi-Fi security ki zaroorat (2): yeh network ko ghair mutalliqa rasai se bachati hai. Security ke baghair koi bhi internet chala sakta hai aur hackers zaati maloomat chura sakte hain; mehfooz Wi-Fi data ko raaz mein rakhti, raftar sust hone se bachati aur performance behtar karti hai.

1. Router web interface: router ki settings sambhalne ke liye. Ise web browser mein router ka IP address likh kar khola jata hai; login ke liye username aur password chahiye. Is se Wi-Fi ka naam aur password badla ja sakta hai aur security settings control hoti hain.

2. Wi-Fi encryption: network par bheje gaye data ko mehfooz shakal mein badal kar bachati hai. WPA2 aur WPA3 aam protocols hain; WEP jaise purane protocols mehfooz nahin. Hamesha naya encryption method chunein.

3. Guest network: mehmanon ko internet deta hai magar main ghar ke network se alag hota hai, is liye mehman zaati devices tak nahin pohanchte. Is se hifazat aur privacy barhti hai, internet ka istemal control hota hai, aur yeh ghar aur daftar dono mein mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: The interface allows changes in Wi-Fi name and password.

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain the ping command and interpret its output 'Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118' (5). Explain the ipconfig and ifconfig commands (3). (8 marks)
(Ping command samjhayein aur is ke output 'Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118' ki tashreeh karein (5). ipconfig aur ifconfig commands samjhayein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Ping (5):
1. Ping command network connectivity test karne ke liye hai; yeh check karti hai ke device tak pohancha ja sakta hai ya nahin.
2. Yeh doosre device ko chhote data packets bhejti hai aur destination se response time napti hai (Figure 1.16).
3. Yeh network delays pakadne mein madad deti hai aur internet connection check karne ke liye aam hai. Ise command prompt par likhte hain, jaise C:\> ping google.com
4. Output: 'Reply from 142.250.190.14' ka matlab destination (google.com, IP address 142.250.190.14) tak rasai hai; 'bytes=32' bheje gaye packet ka size hai; 'time=25ms' response time hai.
5. 24-26 ms ke chaar replies dikhate hain ke connection theek hai aur der kam hai.

ipconfig aur ifconfig (3):
1. Ipconfig Windows mein aur ifconfig Linux aur macOS mein istemal hoti hai.
2. Yeh commands IP address, subnet mask aur network status jaisi settings dikhati hain.
3. Yeh network troubleshooting mein madad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: This command helps detect network delays.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is network troubleshooting and why is it needed (4)? Explain Telnet, PuTTY and SSH for remote access (4). (8 marks)
(Network troubleshooting kya hai aur kyun zaroori hai (4)? Remote access ke liye Telnet, PuTTY aur SSH samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Troubleshooting (4):
1. Network troubleshooting network ke masail dhoond kar theek karna hai; is se connection aur speed ke masail pakde jate hain.
2. Is mein cables, devices aur settings check hoti hain.
3. Is se network downtime aur errors kam hote hain.
4. Raabta hamwar rehta hai aur performance behtar hoti hai. Diagnostic tools (command prompt ya terminal ki commands) sust ya toote connections pehchanne mein madad dete hain.

Remote access (4):
1. Telnet door se device tak rasai ke liye hai, magar data bina encryption bhejta hai.
2. PuTTY remote login ka mashhoor tool hai.
3. SSH remote access ka mehfooz tareeqa hai; yeh hifazat ke liye data encrypt karta hai.
4. Yeh tools network devices ko door se sambhalne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These tools help manage network devices.

blocks.prompt:
14 Define network performance (2). Explain bandwidth and latency (2 x 2). Write any two causes of network delay (2). (8 marks)
(Network performance ki definition likhein (2). Bandwidth aur latency samjhayein (2 x 2). Network delay ki koi do wajahen likhein (2).)
blocks.explanation:
Network performance (2): network kitna achha kaam karta hai; yeh data transfer ki raftar aur miyar dikhati hai. Achhi performance tez aur hamwar raabta deti hai; kharab performance se internet sust aur der hoti hai. Yeh bandwidth aur latency jaise factors par munhasir hai.

Bandwidth (2): diye gaye waqt mein bheja gaya data; network kitna data utha sakta hai. Aam tor par Mbps mein. Zyada bandwidth yani tez transfer; zyada devices zyada bandwidth lete hain; kam bandwidth se internet sust.

Latency (2): data ke safar ka waqt, yani bhejne aur milne ke darmiyan der, milliseconds mein. Kam latency yani tez jawab; zyada latency se lag. Online games aur video calls ko kam latency chahiye.

Delay ki wajahen (2): koi do - bohat zyada users, ghatiya cables, devices ke darmiyan lamba faasla, network congestion, hardware ke masail.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is network load balancing (2)? Write three of its benefits (3). Explain its three basic methods (3). (8 marks)
(Network load balancing kya hai (2)? Is ke teen fawaid likhein (3). Is ke teen bunyadi tareeqe samjhayein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definition (2): network load balancing network traffic sambhalne ke liye hai; yeh kaam ko kai servers ya links mein baantti hai taake aik device par bojh na pade. Yeh bade networks aur data centers mein istemal hoti hai.

Fawaid (3):
1. Network ki raftar aur jawab ka waqt behtar hota hai.
2. Server failure ka khatra kam hota hai: aik server fail ho to baqi kaam karte rehte hain.
3. Zyada traffic aur zyada users aasani se sambhale jate hain, aur bharosa aur dastiyabi barhti hai (behtar user experience).

Tareeqe (3):
1. Round Robin: requests aik aik kar ke bhejta hai.
2. Least Connection: traffic kam masroof servers ko bhejta hai.
3. IP Hash: IP address se traffic ka faisla karta hai.
Yeh saade tareeqe lagane mein aasan hain.

book_ref.quote: These methods balance the network load.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe four common network security threats (4). Explain how a firewall, encryption and access control protect a network (4). (8 marks)
(Network security ke chaar aam khatre bayan karein (4). Samjhayein ke firewall, encryption aur access control network ki hifazat kaise karte hain (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Khatre (4):
1. Viruses aur malware system kharab karte hain.
2. Hackers data churane ki koshish karte hain.
3. Phishing users ko dhoka de kar maloomat leti hai.
4. Denial of Service attacks network services rok dete hain.

Security tools (4):
1. Firewall: security device ya software jo aane jane wala traffic control karta, nuqsandeh ya ghair zaroori data rokta aur mehfooz aur ghair mehfooz networks ke darmiyan deewar banta hai (Figure 1.17).
2. Encryption: data ko khufiya shakal mein badalti hai jise sirf ijazat yafta users parh sakein; transfer ke dauran data bachati hai, emails aur online banking mein istemal hoti hai aur data chori rokti hai.
3. Access control: tay karta hai ke network kaun istemal kare aur sirf ijazat yafta users ko aane deta hai; username aur password aam controls hain aur permissions users ke kaam mehdood karti hain. Yeh aham resources bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: Security tools help reduce these threats.

blocks.prompt:
17 Define data backup and recovery (2). Explain the three types of data backup (3). Explain any three data recovery methods (3). (8 marks)
(Data backup aur recovery ki definition likhein (2). Data backup ki teen qismein samjhayein (3). Data recovery ke koi teen tareeqe samjhayein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Definitions (2): data backup aham data ki copy banana hai taake woh zaya ya kharab hone (viruses ya hardware ki kharabi) se bacha rahe. Recovery data wapas hasil karne ka amal hai.

Backup ki qismein (3):
1. Full backup: sara data aik saath save karta hai.
2. Incremental backup: sirf badla hua data save karta hai.
3. Differential backup: pichhle full backup ke baad ki tabdeeliyan save karta hai.
Backups hard drives ya cloud storage par rakhe ja sakte hain.

Recovery ke tareeqe (3), koi teen:
1. Backup files se zaya data wapas laya jata hai.
2. Recovery software delete shuda files wapas lata hai.
3. System restore system data wapas la sakta hai.
4. Mahireen (professionals) kharab devices se data wapas la sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Backups can be stored on hard drives.

blocks.prompt:
18 Define usability and security (2 x 2). Explain the tradeoff between usability and security with examples (4). (8 marks)
(Usability aur security ki definition likhein (2 x 2). Usability aur security ke darmiyan tradeoff misalon ke saath samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Usability (2): system istemal karna kitna aasan hai. Aasan system saada aur wazeh hota hai, users jaldi seekhte hain, kaam bina uljhan hote hain; waqt aur mehnat bachti hai aur user khush hota hai.

Security (2): systems aur data ki hifazat. Yeh ghair mutalliqa rasai rokti, viruses aur hackers se bachati, maloomat raaz mein rakhti aur khatre aur nuqsan kam karti hai. Har system ko bunyadi security chahiye.

Tradeoff (4):
1. Security barhane se system istemal mein mushkil ho sakta hai.
2. Misal: mazboot passwords yaad rakhna mushkil hai aur extra login steps users ko sust karte hain.
3. Saade system aasan magar kam mehfooz hain, aur security hatane se khatra barhta hai.
4. Is liye mehfooz aur aasan istemal ke liye tawazun (balance) zaroori hai.
